summary: The model substantially diverges from the approved target. Face construction, dorsal shields, anatomy, and foot construction fail visual review. Some required details are obscured or cropped and therefore cannot pass. Deterministic checks report PASS; this does not establish visual compliance.

findings.message: The supplied technical report records PASS_DETERMINISTIC with zero blockers and warnings. These results were not independently verified.
findings.recommendation: Keep deterministic results separate from the visual gate result.

findings.message: Smooth rounded body segments, a rectangular chest panel, short neck, and dome-shaped head replace the target's integrated armored anatomy, elongated reptilian head, and jagged silhouette.
findings.recommendation: Rebuild the primary proportions and connected armored forms around the approved target.

findings.message: The face reads as a smooth dome above broad wedge and rectangular mouth components. Protruding yellow eyes and lateral wedges do not reproduce the target's recessed eyes, swept crown, and coherent reptilian muzzle. Vents and complete jaw alignment cannot be verified; the review panel obscures part of both close-ups.
findings.recommendation: Rework crown, eye sockets, muzzle, jaw, and vents as a coherent face, then provide unobstructed close-ups.

findings.message: Both arms remain externally visible, but the close-ups do not establish clearance along the inner upper arms and torso. Rounded shoulder forms merge visually into the torso, and the hands and lower arms are incompletely framed.
findings.recommendation: Provide views exposing each inner arm boundary from shoulder to wrist and resolve any torso penetration.

findings.message: Both foot close-ups crop out the relevant claw sets. Wider views show small rounded toe forms with thin triangular extensions and apparent separation from the upright foot masses. Every front and rear claw's attachment, taper, and direction cannot be verified.
findings.recommendation: Build connected load-bearing feet with three tapered forward claws and one backward claw each; frame all eight claws completely.

findings.message: The dorsal forms appear as small spaced slabs with sparse yellow marks, rather than the target's large irregular shattered shields. Seven qualifying shield forms cannot be verified.
findings.recommendation: Create seven clearly readable angular fractured shields with substantial silhouettes and integrated bases.

findings.message: Large thighs establish mass, but stacked rounded segments, exposed rectangular joint pieces, and narrow upright foot forms undermine a continuous load-bearing digitigrade structure.
findings.recommendation: Connect thigh, knee, hock, ankle, and broad clawed foot into a convincing digitigrade chain.

criteria.reason: Anatomy, facial construction, proportions, armor, and defining dorsal silhouette differ substantially from the target.
Visible facial components do not form the required coherent target face; complete jaw, vent, and bilateral alignment cannot be verified.
Arms are visible, but the supplied angles do not verify complete inner-arm clearance beyond the shoulder attachments.
Claw close-ups omit the claw sets, and wider views cannot establish correct orientation and attachment of every claw.
Front and side views show an upright torso with free-hanging arms that do not support the body.
A bipedal body and tail remain, but the target's distinctive reptilian head, integrated armor, and imposing shield silhouette are not preserved.
Visible dorsal slabs lack the target's broad fractured shield shapes; seven qualifying forms cannot be confirmed.
Legs outweigh the arms visually, but disconnected-looking segments and inadequate foot construction do not convincingly read as load-bearing digitigrade anatomy.
